concernReporting.title: Concern reporting
concernReporting.intro: Encourage people to report legitimate security concerns with transparent points, ranks and achievement badges.
concernReporting.sectionDescription: This opt-in is independent of the AI assistant. When AI is available it can assess reports immediately; otherwise the CISO reviews them.
concernReporting.switchHint: Award points, ranks and badges for legitimate concern reports.
concernReporting.enabledExplanation: New concern reports enter the rewards workflow. Existing suspended evaluations stay suspended until an administrator explicitly resumes them.
concernReporting.disabledExplanation: Concern reporting continues normally. No new evaluations, points, badges or reward notices are created.
concernReporting.resumed: {count, plural, one {# evaluation queued} other {# evaluations queued}}.

catalog.title: Recognition people can earn
catalog.description: Points build a person’s rank over time, while achievement badges recognize specific kinds of helpful reporting. Results remain private to the reporter and authorized security reviewers.

first_signal.title: First Signal
first_signal.description: First reporter of a confirmed concern.

sharp_eye.title: Sharp Eye
sharp_eye.description: Reported five confirmed or plausible concerns.

early_warning.title: Early Warning
early_warning.description: First to report three separately confirmed concerns.

high_impact.title: High Impact
high_impact.description: Reported a confirmed major or critical concern.

consistent_guardian.title: Consistent Guardian
consistent_guardian.description: Reported useful concerns in three different calendar months.

corroborator.title: Corroborator
corroborator.description: Added useful corroboration to an existing concern.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.intro: The AI assistant helps people describe concerns and suggests controls and frameworks. It never saves or approves anything by itself. Everything works with it off.

errors.forbidden: Your role doesn't include changing AI settings.
errors.unavailable: That didn't save. Please try again in a minute.
errors.notAccepted: That change wasn't accepted. Reload the page and try again.
errors.secretsKeyMissing: The server has no secrets key (AI_SECRETS_KEY), so a provider key can't be stored or used. Ask whoever runs the server to set one.
errors.keyUnreadable: The saved key can't be read, because the server's secrets key has changed since it was saved. Save the key again.
errors.privacyOff: Turn on both privacy switches first.
errors.modelNotOffered: That model is no longer offered. Choose another one.

overall.ready: The AI assistant is on and ready.
overall.noKey: The AI assistant can't run: no key is saved.
overall.privacyOff: AI is paused until both privacy switches are on.
overall.privacyOffZeroRetention: AI is paused until zero data retention is on.
overall.noModel: The AI assistant is on, but some purposes still need a model.
overall.secretsKeyMissing: The AI assistant can't run: the server has no secrets key.
overall.keyUnreadable: The AI assistant can't run: the saved key can't be read.

key.title: Provider key
key.description: The key is stored encrypted and can never be shown again, only its last 4 characters.
key.label: OpenRouter key
key.hint: Paste the whole key. It is cleared from this page as soon as it is saved.
key.invalid: Enter the whole key: 20 to 200 characters, with no spaces.
key.status: A key is set · ends in {last4} · set by {name} on {date}
key.confirmBody: The AI assistant stops working until a new key is saved. Nothing else changes.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Both must be on before any request leaves the workspace.
privacy.euOnlyHint: Requests go only to AI providers hosted in the EU.
privacy.zeroRetentionHint: Providers must not store your prompts or answers.
privacy.paused: AI is paused until both are on.
privacy.pausedZeroRetention: AI is paused until zero data retention is on.
privacy.nonEuWarning: EU-only routing is off: requests may be processed outside the EU. Development only.

models.title: Models
models.description: Choose the model each purpose uses. The list shows only models offered with EU routing and zero retention.

unavailable.privacyOff: Models can be chosen once both privacy switches are on.
unavailable.noKey: Models can be chosen once a key is saved.
unavailable.secretsKeyMissing: Models can't be listed: the server has no secrets key.
unavailable.keyUnreadable: Models can't be listed: the saved key can't be read. Save the key again.
unavailable.provider: OpenRouter didn't list its models just now. Reload the page to try again.

test.title: Test connection
test.description: Sends one harmless request with the saved key and settings.

reasons.noKey: No key is saved yet. Save a key first.
reasons.privacyOff: Turn on both privacy switches first. No request was sent.
reasons.secretsKeyMissing: The server has no secrets key, so the saved key can't be used.
reasons.keyUnreadable: The saved key can't be read. Save the key again.
reasons.auth: The key was rejected by OpenRouter. Check it and save it again.
reasons.regionNotAllowed: Your OpenRouter plan doesn't include EU-only routing. Upgrade to a Business plan, or turn EU-only routing off (development only).
reasons.noEndpoint: No EU-hosted provider available for this model. Choose another model.
reasons.rateLimited: OpenRouter is receiving too many requests. Try again in a minute.
reasons.timeout: OpenRouter didn't answer in time. Try again in a minute.
reasons.unavailable: OpenRouter couldn't be reached. Try again later.

master.title: AI assistant on or off
master.label: AI assistant on/off
master.hint: When it is off, nobody sees AI help. Reporting, controls and frameworks all work without it.
